Chicken Marinade
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 3:45pm

Ingredients




1 teaspoon Fine sliced fresh ginger
2 Cloves garlic
cup Lemon juice
2 teaspoons Brown sugar
cup Olive oil
cup Soy sauce
1 Green onion, chopped

Preparation

1 Combine marinade ingredients. Place in glass bowl or dish that will hold chicken in single layer. Add chicken; let marinate a minimum of 4 hours, turning occasionally. May be left in fridge, covered overnight. Remove chicken from marinade. Grill chicken on barbecue, basting with marinade at intervals, or bake 30 to 45 minutes in 350 F degree oven or until cooked through.
